title: Extradition arrest warrant, HDO filed vs. Apollo Quiboloy --DOJ
summary: An extradition arrest warrant and hold departure order have been filed against Kingdom of Jesus Christ (KOJC) founder Apollo Quiboloy and two of his co-accused, the Department of Justice (DOJ) said…

blocks.text: An extradition arrest warrant and hold departure order have been filed against Kingdom of Jesus Christ (KOJC) founder Apollo Quiboloy and two of his co-accused, the Department of Justice (DOJ) said Friday.

On behalf of the US government, the DOJ filed an extradition petition on Monday against Quiboloy, Teresita Tolibas Dandan, and Helen Panilag in connection with their charges of international human trafficking, sex trafficking, conspiracy, and bulk cash smuggling.
According to the DOJ, the court filed the extradition warrant of arrest on Thursday, November 12, pursuant to Section 4, Rule 2 of the Rules on Extradition Proceedings.

“The court issued an Extradition Warrant of Arrest against the foregoing individuals, after finding probable cause that: (a) each extraditee is the person named in the corresponding foreign arrest warrant and indictment, (b) that the offenses charged are extraditable offenses, and (c) that each extraditee committed the offense or offenses charged,” it said in a statement.
“At the same time, said court likewise issued a Hold Departure Order against each extraditee, to prevent any attempt by each of them to depart from the Philippines,” it added. —VAL, GMA News
